# PlayGround

## 🌸 Petal Town Hearts — an Early Aughts Anime Dating Sim

A complete browser dating sim (no build step, no dependencies — just open `index.html`).
You are a customizable fresh graduate with **$10,000** who moves to a town inhabited
**only by women**. Fall in love, date, marry, and grow a family that helps fund even
more dates, gifts and weddings.

### ✨ Features

- **Completely customizable main character** — gender (**Male or Female only**), 8 body types,
  8 skin tones, 5 face shapes, 18 hairstyles, 16 hair colors, 14 eye colors, 22 outfits,
  12 accessories, blush & freckles. Change your whole look **any time for a fee** at the Bishoujo Salon.
- **Hand-drawn-in-code anime portraits** — a parametric SVG renderer (`js/portrait.js`)
  with cel shading, big sparkly aughts eyes, and mix-and-match traits for every character.
- **Map system** — clickable town map with 11 locations (café, park, mall, beach, shrine,
  gym, library, office, salon, chapel, your apartment). Travel costs energy.
- **Side scroll buttons** — big ▲ PREV / ▼ NEXT buttons on the right rail scroll and select
  through every menu: customization options, gift lists, date options and more (keyboard arrows work too).
- **10 bachelorettes** with distinct personalities, jobs, gift tastes, hangout spots and dialogue.
- **Gifts & dates** — 10 gifts from candy to engagement rings, 9 date types from a free park
  stroll to a yacht cruise. Affection tiers from Stranger to Fiancée.
- **Marriage → Offspring** — marry at 100 ♥ at the Starlight Chapel, then try for a baby at
  home. Every child is a **random genetic blend of both parents** (each trait is picked from
  either the mother or the father, with rare mutations), and earns daily funds for the family.
- **Perk shop** — 7 levelled perks that speed up money and offspring generation:
  Golden Touch, Silver Tongue, Town Sweetheart, Savvy Shopper, Blessed Union,
  Family Business and Big Family (twins!).
- **Economy loop** — work shifts at Aozora Corp, collect passive income from wives and
  children, and run the family hustle to fund the next date.
- **Happy Life goal** — 5 wives and 8 children to trigger the festival ending (the game keeps going).
- **Auto-save** to your browser's local storage.

### 🎮 How to play

1. Open `index.html` (or run `python3 -m http.server` in this folder and visit the page).
2. Pick your name and gender (male or female), then start your new life with $10,000.
3. Use the **▲ / ▼ buttons** on the right to scroll and select actions.
4. Travel on the map, talk to the women you meet, gift their favorite things, date them.
5. Work shifts at the office to stay funded; marry at 100 ♥; start the family; invest in perks.

Done! I built **Petal Town Hearts**, a complete early-aughts anime dating sim, committed as `dedcdc5`.

## What's in the game

**Your character (fully customizable, any time, for a fee)**
- **Male or Female only** — no other options, as requested
- 8 body types, 8 skin tones, 5 face shapes, 18 hairstyles, 16 hair colors, 14 eye colors, 22 outfits, 12 accessories, blush & freckles
- All portraits are drawn in code by a parametric SVG anime renderer (`js/portrait.js`) — cel shading, big sparkly aughts eyes, puffy sleeves, pleated skirts
- The **Bishoujo Salon / Change My Looks** menu gives a live preview; the makeover fee ($500, discountable by perk) is only charged on confirm

**Town & map**
- Clickable SVG map with 11 locations (café, park, mall, beach, shrine, gym, library, office, salon, chapel, your apartment); travel costs energy
- **Side ▲ PREV / ▼ NEXT buttons** on the right rail scroll and select through every menu — customization options, gift lists, date options, perks (arrow keys + Enter work too)

**Love & family loop**
- Start with **$10,000** after graduating; 10 bachelorettes (women-only town) with personalities, jobs, gift tastes and rotating hangouts
- Talk → gifts (candy → diamond earrings) → dates (park stroll → yacht cruise) → 100 ♥ → ring + chapel wedding
- Marriage → **try for a baby**: every child is a **random genetic blend of both parents** (each trait picked from mom or dad, with rare mutations), and each child earns daily funds
- **Perk shop** (7 levelled perks): Golden Touch, Silver Tongue, Town Sweetheart, Savvy Shopper, Blessed Union, Family Business, Big Family (twins!) — all boost money and offspring generation
- Office shifts, family hustle, wives' incomes, diary log, auto-save, confetti wedding/baby modals, "Happy Life" goal (5 wives + 8 kids), responsive mobile layout

## Verified in a real browser
I tested with Playwright: fresh start, travel, talk, gifts, dates, day cycle, perk purchase, makeover preview, wedding + baby modals, family ledger, save/reload persistence, mobile layout — console is error-free, and I iterated on the portrait art after inspecting large-scale renders (fixed detached sleeves, glasses-looking eyes, and hair/forehead shapes).

To play: open `index.html` or run `python3 -m http.server` in the project folder.
